fields.headline: Fast checks for everyday ship-design work
fields.lead: A small collection of browser-based converters, preliminary checks and lookup tools for recurring technical tasks. They are designed for quick reference, not as a substitute for project-specific engineering calculations.

fields.heading: Three tools for common technical checks

items.name: Power Converter
items.desc: Convert quickly between kW, HP, CV and PS when comparing manufacturer data, legacy documentation or technical references from different sources.

items.name: Preliminary Propeller-Shaft Diameter Check
items.desc: Estimate a preliminary minimum diameter from power, shaft speed, gear ratio and material factor before carrying out a complete project calculation.

fields.heading: Common questions about the tools
fields.intro: These answers clarify where quick online checks are useful and where a full project calculation is still needed.

items.title: Can I use the tool result as the final calculation for a vessel project?
items.content: No. The tools are intended for reference and preliminary checks. A project calculation should consider the full input data, load cases, material properties, operating conditions and design assumptions that apply to that vessel.

items.title: Are CV and PS the same unit?
items.content: Both are metric-horsepower units commonly found in manufacturer documentation. The converter makes it easier to compare them with kW and mechanical horsepower (HP).

items.title: Is the shaft-diameter result final or preliminary?
items.content: It is a preliminary check based on the inputs provided. If the value will be used in an actual design, the complete calculation should consider the relevant material, operating and design conditions.

items.title: Where does the engine data come from?
items.content: The current dataset contains more than 250 engine models compiled from vessel design records. For a specific project, the latest manufacturer documentation should still be used as the final technical reference.

items.title: Can I suggest another tool?
items.content: Yes. Send us the recurring calculation or lookup task. If the logic is stable and useful to a wider audience, it may be a good candidate for another public tool.

fields.heading: A quick check is a starting point, not the design
fields.content: When the result affects a real vessel decision, the full operating condition, geometry, loads and other project-specific inputs need to be considered. We can take on the detailed calculation when the online check is no longer enough.

fields.heading: Is there a calculation you keep doing by hand?
fields.description: Send the method, input data and intended use. We can look at whether it makes sense as another public tool or should remain a project-specific calculation.
